s1.syndrome_frame: Acute vision loss in one eye with optic disc swelling and retinal vascular occlusion in a patient undergoing immunotherapy
salient_findings: Sudden vision loss in the right eye
Mild swelling of the optic disc
Occlusion of the superior branch artery
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 40s
Undergoing treatment with systemic steroids, durvalumab, and bevacizumab
Initial visual acuity of 20/25 OU
Right eye showed full visual field
Mild swelling of the optic disc
Peripapillary retinal hemorrhages
Occlusion of the superior branch artery
Combined occlusion of the central retinal artery and vein
Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm
Immunohistochemistry positive for glial fibrillary acid protein and mutant IDH-1 protein

shortlist.label: Glioblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm, and immunohistochemistry was positive for glial fibrillary acid protein and mutant IDH-1 protein

shortlist.label: Bevacizumab-Associated Optic Neuropathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient is undergoing treatment with bevacizumab and developed sudden vision loss in one eye

shortlist.label: Durvalumab-Associated Optic Neuropathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient is undergoing treatment with durvalumab and developed sudden vision loss in one eye

shortlist.label: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has undergone immunotherapy and presented with acute vision loss and optic disc swelling

shortlist.label: Optic Disc Edema
shortlist.why_kept: Mild swelling of the optic disc and peripapillary retinal hemorrhages

raw.rationale: Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm and immunohistochemistry positive for glial fibrillary acid protein and mutant IDH-1 protein, which are characteristic of glioblastoma

rejected.label: Optic Nerve Sheath Meningioma
rejected.why: No evidence of meningioma on imaging studies

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: No lymphoma cells found in vitreous biopsy

rejected.label: Optic Neuritis
rejected.why: Presence of astrocytic neoplasm and peripapillary retinal hemorrhages not typical of optic neuritis

rejected.label: Giant Cell Arteritis
rejected.why: No evidence of giant cell arteritis on laboratory tests or imaging studies
